channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Bridge connecting Canada and U.S. opens after Trump tried to block it
item.dc:creator: Joanna Slater
item.description: The Gordie Howe International Bridge connecting Detroit and Windsor, Ontario, is crucial to trade.

item.title: Zelensky is first foreign leader to visit Burnham, U.K.’s new prime minister
item.dc:creator: Steve Hendrix
item.description: The meeting at a British naval base where Ukrainian military personnel are being trained highlighted ongoing support for Kyiv against Russia.

item.title: Deadly U.S. boat strikes have failed to curb cocaine supply, Pentagon and DEA officials say
item.dc:creator: Alex Horton, Terrence McCoy, Samantha Schmidt, Dylan Moriarty
item.description: The president says Operation Southern Spear has virtually ended drug trafficking by sea. Pentagon and DEA analysts have concluded otherwise.

item.title: See what it’s like to use a North Korean smartphone under Kim Jong Un
item.dc:creator: Michelle Lee
item.description: North Koreans are banking, getting makeup tutorials and using period trackers on their phones. But under Kim, these digital comforts are also tools of control.
